pages.title: Long Before Yesterday
pages.text: Obtain an Eye of Methuselah and an Archstone Pillar.

pages.title: Long Before Yesterday
pages.text: Prepare the real gateway into ancient epochs.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the Journey Guide to find the temple and follow its native challenge. Build the Forgotten Portal using the guide’s full arrangement; the eye is never a journal reward.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Defeat the Methuselah boss in the temple and collect its eye. Eye needed to activate a completed forgotten portal.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Find a forgotten portal, make its four portal corners correspond to the same era and complete the archstone pillars; activate it with the Eye of Methuselah. Travel to the selected Cenozoic dimension.
